text: Finished the whole Bioenergetics question bank today! 🌿 Remember: in photophosphorylation, non-cyclic produces both ATP and NADPH, while cyclic only produces ATP. Good luck everyone with the upcoming MDCAT mocks!
Quick integration trick for FAST and NUST tests: when you see ∫ (f'(x)/f(x)) dx, it is always ln|f(x)| + C. Saved me 2 minutes on the speed drill today! 📐
